Simulated textile images

Source: R/data.R
textiles.Rd

Fifty simulated images of a woven textile, 250 x 250 pixels. Half of them show a flaw in the pattern. Use them to test a decision model on an image task. The files are in the folder extdata/textiles of the installed package: system.file("extdata", "textiles", package = "decisions").

Usage

textiles

Format

A tibble with 50 rows and 5 columns:

file

Character. The name of the JPEG file in extdata/textiles of the installed package. The name starts with the folder of the source (nominal_, local_ or global_), because two source files have the same name.

class

Factor. The truth, with the levels nominal and defective. Each level has 25 images.

defect_type

Factor. nominal (no flaw), local (a flaw in one place) or global (a flaw that changes the whole pattern).

role

Character. reference (4 images, to show the model what each answer looks like) or input (46 images, to decide on).

reference_rank

Integer. 1 or 2 for the references, two for each class, and NA for the inputs.

Source

Made with the R package spc4sts:

Bui, A. T., & Apley, D. W. (2021). spc4sts: Statistical process control for stochastic textured surfaces in R. Journal of Quality Technology, 53(3), 219-242. doi:10.1080/00224065.2019.1707730

The CRAN page of spc4sts, which links its reference manual: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=spc4sts

The images are shared in the public repository https://github.com/fmegahed/qe_genai (MIT license). The 4 references are the images of rank 1 and 2 of each class among the images that the benchmark of that repository leaves open for training and design. The 46 inputs are 23 images of each class, drawn at random with a fixed seed from the same open images; none is a reference. No image that the benchmark keeps for testing is in the data. The script https://github.com/fmegahed/decisions/blob/main/data-raw/textiles.R builds the data.

Examples

table(textiles$role, textiles$class)
#>            
#>             nominal defective
#>   input          23        23
#>   reference       2         2
paths <- file.path(
  system.file("extdata", "textiles", package = "decisions"), textiles$file
)
file.exists(paths[1])
#> [1] TRUE
